meta.source: BU housing API scrape, Spring 2026 selection (Mar 22 – Apr 2, 2026)
meta.note: openRooms=rooms with >=1 open space; emptyRooms=rooms with every space open; grid arrays align to gridStart+i*stepMinutes. windows[] align with atWindowOpen arrays. fillBuckets counts rooms by when they last became full: preInternal (already gone at scrape start), per class window (attributed to the latest window started; slots stay open so late picks land in later windows), neverFilled (still open at end, 4/2). internal_soph start is estimated; internal anchors are low-confidence. spacesTaken = net spaces (people) taken per window (taken minus freed), attributed to the latest window started when the change was observed.
